name: psb-cv-builder
description: Generate tailored CVs/resumes by matching job requirements against documented professional experience

commands.title: PSB: Generate Tailored CV
commands.description: Generate a tailored CV based on a job description by matching against your documented experience

tools.name: generate-cv
tools.description: Generate a tailored CV/resume by matching job requirements against documented professional experience

jobDescription.description: The job description, role title, or requirements to match against. Can be full JD or brief title.

format.description: Output format: resume (1-page), cv (detailed), or linkedin (profile)

maxLength.description: Maximum length in pages (for resume/cv) or characters (for linkedin). Default: 1 page for resume, 2 pages for cv

targetLevel.description: Target career level for the CV

focusAreas.description: Optional areas to emphasize (e.g., ['Cloud Architecture', 'Cost Optimization'])
